mountpoint.description: Local directory where the MTP device will be mounted.

device.description: Specific device identifier in format 'busnum,devnum'. Leave empty to auto-detect the first device.

fuse_opts.description: List of FUSE options to pass to the underlying fuse filesystem. Common options include 'allow_other', 'uid', 'gid', 'default_permissions'. See fuse(8) for details.
